_comment: Store screenshot copy and styling, in one place because every store reads
it. tool/screenshot_job.dart turns this into a moksha job; moksha renders
the finished images and checks them against each store's upload rules.
Scene ids match the capture names the integration test writes. Add a
screen there and add it here.
`background`, `layouts` and font names must be ones moksha knows. Run
`npm run render -- --schema` in a moksha checkout to list them.
These are store copy, not UI strings: write the benefit, not the feature.
Most people never scroll past the first two, so `hosts` and `sessions`
have to carry the whole app between them.
Keep a headline short enough to read at thumbnail size; the subhead is
the second read, for someone who has already stopped.

subhead.en-US: Groups, tags and jump hosts. Import the ~/.ssh/config you already have.
subhead.ne-NP: समूह, ट्याग र जम्प होस्ट। पहिल्यै भएको ~/.ssh/config आयात गर्नुहोस्।

headline.en-US: A dropped connection keeps your work

subhead.en-US: A real terminal, running inside tmux, picking up where it left off.
subhead.ne-NP: साँचो टर्मिनल, tmux भित्र चल्छ र जहाँको त्यहीँबाट फेरि सुरु हुन्छ।

headline.en-US: Keys you make on the device

subhead.en-US: Ed25519 in a tap, or import the ones you have. Swap a password for a key, verified first.
subhead.ne-NP: एक ट्यापमा Ed25519, वा आफ्ना कुञ्जी आयात। पासवर्डको साटो कुञ्जी, जाँचेपछि मात्र।

headline.en-US: Port forwards you don't have to remember

subhead.en-US: Local and remote forwards, saved and started from a list.
subhead.ne-NP: लोकल र रिमोट फर्वार्ड, सूचीबाटै सेभ गरेर सुरु गर्नुहोस्।

subhead.en-US: No account, no backend. Credentials stay in the system keychain.
subhead.ne-NP: न खाता, न सर्भर। पासवर्ड र कुञ्जी सिस्टमकै कीस्टोरमा रहन्छन्।
